title: Sustainable Architecture

locators.note: Passive design and passive cooling reduce operating cost and environmental impact after higher initial effort.
Passive design in the tropics emphasizes natural ventilation, low thermal mass, shading, and careful glazing.
Site planning should orient openings to prevailing winds, use operable windows and ceiling vents, and add shaded verandas, balconies, and landscaping.
Passive and mixed-mode ventilation can reduce air-conditioning dependence when openings and stack effect are planned.
Green building in tropical climates reduces cooling load by filtered air movement, shade, and vegetation that does not block circulation.

real_world_scenario: A Cebu barangay library is being designed on a hot, humid site with limited operating budget. The source-safe move is to reduce cooling demand before adding active equipment: orient openings to seasonal winds, keep windows shaded and operable, use verandas or deep balconies as shaded buffers, and place vegetation so it cools the microclimate without blocking air movement.
